title: Capstone: A Plant-Floor Alert Feed
description: Capstone: subscribe to three machines' telemetry with one MQTT wildcard, archive every reading, publish over-threshold readings to a keyed Kafka topic, and load the alerts into MySQL without duplicates.

checks.label: Your MQTT parent subscribes to all three machines with one wildcard (telemetry_to_kafka.ktr has factory/line1/+/telemetry)
Your MQTT child publishes alerts to Kafka (process_telemetry.ktr has a Kafka producer step)
Your loader reads the alerts from Kafka (alerts_to_mysql.ktr has a Kafka consumer step)
Your pipeline archived the readings (telemetry.txt in out\)
Your README.md in solution\ (how to start, run, stop and check the feed)
